meta.name: alfworld-heat-object-with-appliance
meta.description: Uses a heating appliance (microwave, stoveburner, oven) to apply heat to a specified object. Use when the task requires warming or cooking an item (e.g., "heat some egg", "warm the mug") and a heating appliance is available. Takes the object name and appliance name as input and outputs the object in a heated state, ready for placement at the task's target location.

copy.tagline: 用加热电器把指定物品变热
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模拟环境中用微波炉或烤箱加热物品
copy.tagline_en: Heat a specified object using an appliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to heat items using a microwave or oven in a simulated environment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据指令使用微波炉、灶头或烤箱等加热器具，对指定物体（如鸡蛋、杯子）进行加热或烹饪，然后将加热后的物体放到任务要求的位置。
howto.when: 当你说出“加热某个物品”或“把某物弄热”等要求时，并且附近有可用的加热器具。

say.note: Claude 会找到鸡蛋并用微波炉加热。
Claude 会取牛奶并在微波炉里加热。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can heat or cook a specified object using an appliance like microwave, stoveburner, or oven, then put the heated object at the target location.
howto.when_en: When you give a command like "heat some egg" or "warm the mug" and a heating appliance is available.

say_en.note: Claude will find the egg and heat it in the microwave.
Claude will take the milk and heat it in the microwave.
